sources.title: Jacques Le Goff, “Memória,” in História e memória, Portuguese translation by Bernardo Leitão and Irene Ferreira (Campinas: Editora da UNICAMP, 1990).
sources.citation: Jacques Le Goff, “Memória,” in História e memória (Campinas: Editora da UNICAMP, 1990), selected printed pp. 427–430, 458–460 and 475–478. Chapter translation credited to Bernardo Leitão and Irene Ferreira at its end.

verification.note: Primary Portuguese translation checked through repository PDF text: catalogue and chapter translator credits; selected passages on Goody (printed 427–430), Yates(458–460), and complete conclusion(475–478). Internal printed-page markers differ from PDF pagination. Corroborating Italian Memoria transcription also checked; neither whole book, French manifestation nor underlying Goody/Yates works newly read. Translation 1990 is not an original essay date. Historical claims and vocabulary remain Le Goff’s situated interpretations.
